parole.significato: A savory snack (chaat) made with moth beans, popular in Nepal and the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
parole.testo: From Hindi दालमोठ (dālmoṭh) or Nepali दालमोट (dālmoṭ), a compound of Hindi दाल (dāl) + Hindi मोठ (moṭh).

parole.significato: Any of three species of pheasant in the genus Lophophorus.
parole.testo: Said to be from Hindi मोनाल (monāl) or Nepali मुनाल (munāl).
